contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED on the p2 Summary Page, a handwritten oval ZERO (read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling), corroborated by summary line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)', also an oval zero. contributions.detail: Schedule A (p3) carries NO entries. The only handwriting anywhere on the ruled grid is a single large 'N/A' scrawled diagonally across the Name-of-Contributor column over bands 2-3, with no date, no address and no amount beside it. Under the frozen contract that is an ANNOTATION, not an entry - and specifically 'N/A' is on the nil-mark list that stays BLANK, never a numeral - so the honest state is empty-schedule with ZERO rows, not a row with a blank amount. A 900 dpi crop of the footer (pct:70,84.0,26,10@p3) RENDERED the printed labels 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) $' over two EMPTY rules - the filer wrote nothing on either. So: 0 rows = 0.00 = the cover's Column A oval zero = summary line 4. Column B Year-to-Date is likewise an oval zero and is never summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE on the p2 Summary Page, a handwritten oval ZERO (read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling), corroborated by summary line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)', also an oval zero. Schedule B's own two footer lines are BOTH BLANK.
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p4) carries NO entries. As on Schedule A the only handwriting on the grid is a single large 'N/A' scrawled across the payee column, here over bands 4-5 - an annotation, not an entry, and a nil mark that never becomes a numeral. A 900 dpi crop of the footer (pct:70,84.0,26,10@p4) RENDERED 'Subtotal for this page $' and 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $' over two EMPTY rules. So: 0 rows = 0.00 = the cover's Column A line 2 oval zero = summary line 6. Column B YTD is an oval zero and is not summed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable - both schedules are empty and this form prints no in-kind column or line anywhere. Both the monetary-only and the monetary-plus-in-kind conventions give 0.00, which is what every printed anchor states.
itemized.escalation_note: Two 900 dpi footer crops (p3 and p4) to settle whether the printed 'Subtotal for this page' / 'Total ... Received' lines carry a figure or a nil glyph. Both pages: both lines genuinely blank. The 'N/A' scrawls themselves were legible at 200 dpi and needed no escalation.

geometry.provenance: printed-rule detection on the rendered page (scripts/campaign_finance/rowbands.py, raw-render frame): per-page frame = the Amount column band x one measured band per printed table row; a row's box is their intersection, in pct of the page as poppler renders it (rotation included)

The summary page was located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading. A ZERO REPORT: all nine summary cells are the filer's hand-drawn oval zeros; the ladder is internally exact (0 + 0 - 0 = 0).
